notes.title: UPDATE : The new release date is July 22nd!
notes.notes:
Hi, I'm Hitan from Hapiwaku the development team of Incremental Epic Hero!
Last month, we released the Playtest of Incremental Epic Hero 2.
We are tremendously grateful for all of your feedback, as more people participated in our playtest than we originally anticipated, you have helped us to make many positive changes to the game. Thank you so much for your help with that. However, our original timetable for completing certain objectives has, as a result, been delayed, and there are several more features and mechanics that we feel must be present in the game before we release it to early access.
This means that our original release date of June 10th is no longer feasible. 

Official Launch on July 22nd and New Playtest Launch on June 10th!
Then we have determined the new release date on July 22nd. 
We will also start the new IEH2 Playtest on June 10th! At that time, we will wipe the saves of IEH2 Playtest since we've added a lot of content and changed the balance around even for early game. We are really grateful for everyone participating in the IEH2 Playtest. I'm sorry that we need to reset the saves, so much has changed that in order to get the quality of feedback we need for further balancing, this is an unfortunate, but necessary, course of action. However, we’ll be distributing appreciation gifts in the June 10th patch for you all, as our way of saying thank you for participating and helping us make this game great! 

Playtest/IEH1 Players Appreciations Gifts
At the new Playtest ver. 0.3.0.0 launch on June 10th

- For participants of IEH2 Playtest before June 10th:
3000 Nitro
Enables to switch nitro speed from x2 to x3

At the official launch on July 22nd
- For participants of IEH2 Playtest before June 10th:
3000 Nitro
Some amount of Epic Coin
- For participants of IEH2 Playtest regardless date:
Portal Orbs (The amount is determined by Steam Achievement # you get in Playtest)
Some amount of Epic Coin 
- For IEH1 Players:
 Special Talismans  (The amount is determined by Steam Achievement # you get in IEH1. Talismans are extra boosts of stats in game.)

Caution : The gifts are subject to change


So, if you already joined in IEH2 Playtest before June 10th, you will be able to play the new playtest from June 10th with super speed nitro (x3 speed, not x2). You will also get the starting boost with 3000 nitro on both new playtest and real launch! In addition, we will implement Steam Achievement in the new playtest, that will be the same as in the real launch. According to the number that you get the achievements, you will get the starting boost of Portal Orbs at the real launch too! (Portal Orbs are the limited items that you can get several amount per day from daily quests, and are used for entering dungeons, that is one of the greatest way to level heroes.)
Again, we are really appreciate to you all for giving us wonderful feedback! We will keep developing the game and improve more and more with you all 😄
Thank you for continued supports!

To get more information, why not join our Discord!

notes.title: [ver. 1.4.2.0] New Curse of Reincarnation Update!
notes.notes:
[ver. 1.4.2.0]
Added : Three new Curse of Reincarnation (Road of Warrior 3, Road of Wizard 3, Road of Angel 3)
Added : New Hidden Mission Milestone (325&350)
Added : Chinese and Japanese translations for Slime Bank
Balanced : Buffed the spawn chance of Purple Devil Fish in every wave of Area 7-5 so that you can complete the mission easier.
Balanced : Buffed a bit alchemy point stats
Fixed : Display bugs and typos

Thank you as always for enjoying IEH! :D
We are so glad to see you excited at our game! We keep developing to improve IEH more and more :)
We are currently working for a major update, which we will soon announce the detail about it!
Please look forward to it XD

notes.title: [ver. 1.4.0.0] Steam Launch & [ver. 1.4.0.1] Hotfix Updates
notes.notes:
[ver. 1.4.0.0] MAJOR UPDATE STEAM LAUNCH !!!
Added : Hidden Areas, which is unleashed when you complete Area 8-1
Added : Hidden Mission Milestone
Added : New Curse "Explorer's Nightmare"
Added : New Curse "Metal Curse"
Added : New Epic Store Stuffs in Ambition 3
Added : Cloud Save comes back again!
Added : New BGM! (So please turn it on again :D)
Added : Japanese Translation! (Currently, only a few part of them are translated, but future updates will do rest of all)
Balanced : Banana is now available for monsters only when your DPS exceeds 1% of their HP.
Balanced : Buffed Fox Coat in Craft
Balanced : Buffed Iron Hero Sword in Craft
Balanced : Divine Stance damage increasements is reduced at lv 1500 and above
Fixed and Balanced : Area 8-8 Mission
Fixed : Scale Ring bug
Fixed : Removed Skill Level Cap
Fixed : Favorite Equip display
Fixed : Mission Milestone 375 and 384
Fixed : Hold wing's stance check triggered on activation allowing multiple activations per second through repeated clicks
Fixed : Dodge text now counts as a damage text (you can now disable dodge text too)
Fixed : Negative Reputation Increasing by Reincarnation Upgrade
Fixed : Other minor bugs

[ver. 1.4.0.1] Hotfix
Fixed : DLC is now available!
Fixed : Curse "Explorer's Nightmare" display bug

Added : Bonus Code "IEHsteam"

There was a bug that DLCs are freely distributed for all players when downloading the game. This bug is now fixed and accidental distribution is removed. For those who purchased premium upgrades in Epic Store with the free Epic Coins before fixing, the negative Epic Coins bug occurs until you gain enough Epic Coins to raise up to positive amount. You can gain Epic Coins through playing the game and purchasing in Epic Store or DLCs. (DLCs are now available.)
We added a bonus code "IEHsteam" which gives you 1000 Epic Coins for apologize. Please input this bonus code in System tab.
